# Anthropic's Claude API (external)

> Anthropic's Messages API (api.anthropic.com), as far as this repository asks Claude for one whole answer through the official Python SDK, always with the key the customer saved in the Platform's settings.

## Identity

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `EXT-ANTHROPIC-API` |
| Kind | external |
| Owner | `ROLE-ENGINE-OWNER` |

## Purpose

### Not responsible for

- Holding a key; each call carries the key from the Platform's settings registry, never from a file or the environment of the caller.
- Deciding what Claude reads; the caller sends it (for the Knovas Assistent, only the passages the person's own search returned, the question and its history).
- Checking the answer; the Knovas Assistent's check does (statements with a source and a quote).

### Terms

- fallback (Anthropic's server-side retry of a request on another model when the requested one declines on policy grounds; asked for with fallbacks "default")
- refusal (an answer that stops with stop_reason refusal; its text is not an answer)

## Offers

### Operations

| Id | Name | Entrance | Ref |
|---|---|---|---|
| `messages` | POST /v1/messages (the SDK's client.beta.messages.create, beta server-side-fallback-2026-07-01) - one whole answer, not streamed, with effort, the fallback and no temperature | http | `/v1/messages` |

## Contract

### `messages`

#### Promises

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EXT-ANTHROPIC-API/messages/P-1` | A request with model, max_tokens, system, messages, output_config.effort and fallbacks "default" (beta header server-side-fallback-2026-07-01) is answered whole: the answer's text is its text blocks, beside which it may hold thinking and fallback blocks, and stop_reason says end_turn, max_tokens (cut) or refusal. | standard | kind: test, ref: `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_assistant_providers.py`, checks: `test_through_the_real_sdk_the_wire_carries_the_ordered_request`; `test_the_text_is_the_text_blocks_joined`; `test_a_refusal_fails`; `test_a_cut_answer_is_passed_on_as_it_is_and_the_check_drops_its_last_line` |
| `EXT-ANTHROPIC-API/messages/P-2` | An error is an HTTP status the SDK raises as its own class: 429 rate limited and 529 overloaded (ask again later), 401 a refused key, 403 a key without access to the model, any other status a failure; no answer is no connection or a timeout. | standard | kind: test, ref: `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_assistant_providers.py`, checks: `test_through_the_real_sdk_an_http_error_maps_the_same`; `test_through_the_real_sdk_no_connection_and_a_timeout_fail` |

#### Limits

| Id | Statement | Risk class |
|---|---|---|
| `EXT-ANTHROPIC-API/messages/L-1` | No temperature (the current models refuse it) and no thinking setting (adaptive thinking is the default and cannot be switched off on claude-opus-5-5); thinking counts against max_tokens. | standard |
